name: Stardew Valley
notes: Build 16826371: the Windows game is playable with a duplicate macOS cursor in the normal configuration. The optional, reversible cursor guard passed a menu/focus check; gameplay and save/reload with it enabled remain unverified. No extra launch options are needed.

cursorGuard.guidance: When enabled, show only the game's drawn cursor while its managed window is frontmost. The macOS pointer returns on Command-Tab, game exit or Stop Windows Steam. Stop Windows Steam before changing this setting.
